thread:
sam: Heads-up — I'm seeing slowdowns when the console calls /permissions/evaluate and the external authz times out. UX shows a spinner forever. Can we add a circuit-breaker + fallback so admins aren't blocked?

marta: +1. Current behavior is a 2s timeout then we return an error. Proposal: timeout -> fallback to cached snapshot and mark view as 'stale'. But cache staleness is a risk.

alex: UX idea: surface a banner: 'Permission check timed out — showing cached view (last refreshed 12m ago)'. Emit telemetry: permission_eval.timeout and permission_view.fallback=true so we can quantify impact.

kyle: For enterprise tenants, falling back could incorrectly show allowed actions. Legal/security wants explicit tenant-level opt-in and an audit flag when fallback is used.

sam: Sounds reasonable. For self-serve default to allow cached-preview, but enterprise default OFF. Add a guard in tenant settings: 'Allow cached permission preview'.

marta: Implementation sketch: extend API /v1/permissions/evaluate to accept an optional query param `prefer_cache=true` and return an `eval_source` field with values `live|cache|fallback`. Example request body: ```json
{ "principal": "svc-frontend", "route": "/v1/generate", "context": { "model": "gpt-open-xxl" } }
```
and response: ```json
{ "allowed": true, "eval_source": "cache", "cache_ts": "2026-03-20T12:34:00Z" }
```
(backend will annotate).

alex: Telemetry plan: add metric `permission_eval.latency_ms` + `permission_eval.source` tag, and counters `permission_eval.timeout`, `permission_eval.fallback_used`. Also emit an event when a later live-eval contradicts the cached view (fallback_regression).

rbac-bot: INC(ENG-4721) created — permission-eval-circuit-breaker. Assigned @marta. Priority: P2.

kyle: Rollout suggestion: start internal tenants -> 24h canary with sampling 5% production requests -> escalate to 100% for self-serve. For enterprise require manual opt-in + acceptance email. Make the opt-in reversible.

sam: UX: should admins be able to request an on-demand live re-check? I think add a 'Re-check permissions' button on the preview that triggers async live eval and updates view. Show spinner and last live timestamp.

marta: Agree. Copy suggestion: 'Permissions preview may be stale. Click "Re-check" to fetch a live evaluation (may take up to 5s). Actions will be disabled until a live result is returned unless tenant setting allows cached-preview.'

alex: I'll add a console dashboard tile: 'Permission eval timeouts' with trendline, by-tenant heatmap, and top routes causing timeouts. That will help prioritize infra fixes vs UI fallbacks.

sam: One more API question: should the fallback response include an `audit_note` or flag we can surface in audit logs? Ops wants a machine-readable marker so we can search for any action performed while fallback=true.

marta: Yes — include `fallback: true` + `fallback_reason: "timeout"` and `fallback_origin: "cache"` in the response. We will also emit an audit event `permission_view.fallback` with tenant_id + request_id.

kyle: Security check: make sure fallback responses don't expand the set of visible actions for non-admin users. Default UI policy: hide destructive controls when eval_source != live, unless tenant explicitly allows.

sam: Great. I'll summarize in the canary checklist and tag infra to increase authz eval capacity if the dashboard shows high timeout rates.

marta: Putting design/impl tasks in the ticket. I'll draft the admin modal copy and open a PR for API shape this afternoon.

alex: Ping me when PR is ready — I'll wire telemetry and dashboard.
